function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_custom_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of custom event specifications configured within the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project for which to retrieve event specifications.

function.description: Retrieves a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications within the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ids.description: A list of unique identifiers for the built-in events to retrieve.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_system_rules
function.description: Retrieve a list of all the system-defined rules for custom event specifications, which can be used to configure and manage custom events within the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_category.description: The category of the event for which the system rules are requested. For example, 'security' or 'system'.

active_only.description: A flag indicating whether to return only active rules. If true, only rules that are currently active will be returned.
